topic: single-artifact gate result (v4) and an inconclusive partition experiment (v5)

scheduling_plateau.conclusion: three scheduling variants all land at 0.75 within the gate. The candidate got ~9% faster in absolute terms but the vendor reading in the newer windows was also faster, so the ratio did not move. Scheduling parameters are exhausted as a lever.

v5_partition.change: per-core contiguous partition (base = (core*iters+step)*rows*d) instead of the interleaved stride, hypothesised to raise DMA efficiency
v5_partition.conclusion: inconclusive - real external contention appeared on the measurement device during both attempts. No claim is made about the partition change.

status: decode is certified EXCEED on a single artifact; prefill is 0.757 and fails; the partition hypothesis is untested
next: re-measure v5 when the device is genuinely quiet; if the partition does not help, the remaining structural lever is DMA efficiency itself
